columns.frame_description: Down in the valley, Devta 2 runs desperately for his life across the smoking rubble, pursued closely by a pack of snarling Asura soldiers brandishing heavy maces.
columns.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: temptation spoken~valley cutaway) Devta 2 sprints over shattered marble slabs -> stumbles -> glances back in terror; three Asura soldiers chase 5 meters behind with raised weapons
columns.orientation: Devta 1 & 2-Profile facing right; Asura Soldier-Profile facing right
columns.sound_effects: Frantic running footfalls on gravel + clattering iron armor + snarling demonic pursuit shouts

columns.frame_description: Looking down at the slaughter in close-up, Durvasa's fierce eyes soften for a heartbreaking moment as a single tear of profound sorrow wells along his lower eyelid with the camera drifting slowly toward his eye.
columns.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: valley pursuit seen~sage's grief) Durvasa's eyelid twitches -> a single tear wells in the corner of his eye -> slides down sun-weathered cheek crease -> lips remain tightly pressed as the camera drifts closer toward his pupil
columns.orientation: Maharishi Durvasa-3/4 front facing right
columns.sound_effects: Cold wind sighing over rock + muffled distant weapon clatter

columns.frame_description: In full-body framing, the camera circles around Gandaberunda and Durvasa as the demon towers above the rigid sage on the ridge, sneering with mocking triumph over the vow of silence.
columns.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: tear falls~beast mocks silence) In full shot, Gandaberunda circles behind Durvasa -> snaps beaks in mockery -> thrusts heads closer from above -> demands an answer to mock the sacred vow of silence
columns.orientation: Gandaberunda-3/4 front facing right; Maharishi Durvasa-3/4 front facing left
columns.dialogue: GANDABERUNDA: Ab bata, Durvasa… tera Maun Devlok ko kaise bachayega?
columns.sound_effects: Sneering dual-beak taunt + rising wind whistling past ridge stones

dialogue_segments.speaker: GANDABERUNDA
dialogue_segments.text: Ab bata, Durvasa… tera Maun Devlok ko kaise bachayega?

columns.frame_description: High above the valley floor, the camera frames the tiny remnant of Devtas led by Indra and Airawat throwing themselves into a final suicidal clash against the vast black horde of Asuras.
columns.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: taunt lands~final valley clash) The tiny golden wedge of Devtas clashes directly into the massive black wall of the Asura army; Airawat trumpets; weapons spark across the dark plain
columns.orientation: Indra-3/4 front facing left; Asura Army-3/4 front facing right
columns.sound_effects: Distant thunderous clash of thousands of weapons + resonant trumpet of Airawat

columns.frame_description: In a rapid vertical macro track-in along Durvasa's facial axis—from ash tripundra to clamped jaw—his tear evaporates under surging wrath as his dark eyes blaze with restrained fury before a hard cut to black.
columns.camera_movement: Rapid vertical macro track-in with razor-sharp hold
columns.character_action: (Continuation from previous shot: valley clash~eyes ignite) Durvasa's jaw muscles lock like iron -> veins swell across his temples -> eyes blaze with suppressed fury -> maintains unbroken silence until hard cut
columns.orientation: Maharishi Durvasa-3/4 front facing right
columns.sound_effects: Abrupt acoustic drop into dead silence with zero sound decay
